sentences.text: Samarpita Ghosh vs Kaushik Ghosh on 6 November, 2024

M/L 99
06.11.2024
Court. No. 5
suvayan
 Co 885 of 2024
 Samarpita Ghosh
 Vs.
 Kaushik Ghosh
 Mr. Manas Kumar Das

. 
 1.
Praying inter alia for transfer of the Matrimonial Suit No. 178 of 2023 pending before the Court of the learned Additional District Judge at Bolpur, Birbhum to the Court of the learned Additional District Judge at Kandi, Murshidabad the present revisional application has been filed.

entities.text: Additional District Judge at Bolpur, Birbhum
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Court of the learned Additional District Judge at Kandi, Murshidabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. The petitioner would submit that a complaint case has already been registered in Burwan under Sections 498A, 325, 326, 328, 307 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code and under Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act being P.S. Case No. 381 of 2023.

A proceeding under Section 125 of the Cr.P.C. is also pending before the Court of the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kandi,
Murshidabad.

entities.text:
Court of the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kandi,
Murshidabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Another proceeding is also pending before the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kandi, Murshidabad under the provisions of Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act 2005.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kandi, Murshidabad
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act 2005
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. It is submitted that it has become extremely difficult for the petitioner to travel to the Court of the learned Additional District Judge at Bolpur, Birbhum to defend the Matrimonial Suit as the petitioner is required to travel approximately 100 kilometers to reach the Court of the learned Additional District Judge at Bolpur, Birbhum from her residence at Burwan, Murshidabad.

entities.text: Court of the learned Additional District Judge at Bolpur, Birbhum
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Court of the learned Additional District Judge at Bolpur, Birbhum
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 4. Having heard the learned Advocate for the petitioner let the above revisional application be served on plaintiff/opposite party.
5. List this matter in the Monthly List of December, 2024.

(Raja Basu Chowdhury, J.)
